faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-II position at NIT Tiruchirappalli?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II post is 29th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in CSE/IT/ECE/EEE or equivalent, with a preference for M.E/M.Tech in CSE/IT or equivalent, along with 2 years of industry or academic experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Project Associate-II recruitment at NIT Tiruchirappalli is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a written test, if deemed necessary, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-II position at NIT Tiruchirappalli is a contractual role.
